note: Kith expeditions from Thornwick (src/kith/expedition.ts). Each has ONE stated goal (a rare thing or a technique, which is a trait the kith learns) and trains one attribute on the way. 'test' is the attribute the kith needs; 'hard' the number it is measured against. 'days' counts each time the story moves on. 'land' must be reachable.

expeditions.name: The Kerrow ledges
expeditions.text: Up the gorge walls where the leapers nest, ledge to ledge.

goal.text: Learn to keep its feet on any ground (sure-footed).

expeditions.name: Down the old drove road
expeditions.text: Walk the whole drove road with a herd, the old way, and come back with a drover's bell.

goal.text: Bring back a drove bell (a charm fitting).

expeditions.name: A night in the cloud forest
expeditions.text: Alone in the cloud forest from dusk to dawn, finding its way back by smell.

goal.text: Learn to see and fight in the dark (night-eyed).

expeditions.name: The high moss beds
expeditions.text: Up to the duskwort beds with the gatherers, where the slopes are loose and the weather turns.

goal.text: Learn to hold its nerve in bad weather (storm-calm).

expeditions.name: Swim the weir
expeditions.text: Against the current below Weirbank, every morning for a week.

goal.text: Learn to fight well near water (water-born).

expeditions.name: The Cinderwick slag heaps
expeditions.text: Across the hot slag behind the foundries, where the ground smokes.

goal.text: Learn to bear heat and fire (heat-proof).

expeditions.name: The storm roost
expeditions.text: To the crags where the storm-crested mistwings moult.

goal.text: Bring back a storm-crested feather (a charm fitting).
